title: Police Body Camera Footage at 210 Farm St

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the New York Freedom of Information Law, I hereby request the following records:

All body-worn camera (BWC) footage, including any audio recordings, captured by officers responding to 210 Farm St on or about September 18, 2026. This request includes footage from all officers present at the scene, any in-car dashboard camera recordings, and associated metadata (officer name, activation/deactivation times, GPS data). If footage has been redacted or withheld, please provide a Vaughn index identifying each withholding and the specific exemption claimed.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 5 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Eamon Corbo

title: All 911 call recordings and CAD logs related to 210 Farm St

communications.subject: New York Freedom of Information Law Request: All 911 call recordings and CAD logs related to 210 Farm St
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the New York Freedom of Information Law, I hereby request the following records:

All 911 call audio recordings and computer-aided dispatch (CAD) logs related to 210 Farm St on or about September 18, 2026. This includes the original 911 call recording(s), dispatcher audio, CAD event chronology with timestamps, unit assignment records, and any notes entered by dispatchers or responding officers. Please provide audio recordings in their original digital format.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 5 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Eamon Corbo
